headline.note: The official record supplies month boundaries for the family business and Local Government Procurement role, but not hours, leave, payroll basis or substantive full-time status. Local elected office, party activity, board and association governance, advisory service and study are excluded. Overlapping roles and the public/private control of Local Government Procurement remain unresolved; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.role: Bachelor's degree student (Politics and International Relations; French)
career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary biography reports the UNSW fields of study and says Laxale joined the family business after graduating, but gives no enrolment or graduation dates, load, or work overlap.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the employer, combined titles and November 2004 to November 2017 boundaries. The secondary biography identifies it as the family hair-and-beauty supplies business. The legal entity, ownership, remuneration, hours, leave and title transitions are unresolved, including overlap with party and elected roles.
career_spells.counting_note: A senior title in a family business does not prove self-employment or substantive full-time work.

career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary biography reports Labor membership from 2004 and Eastwood branch presidency from 2008. No end date, remuneration, hours or employment relationship is stated; the two milestones are retained in one excluded party-activity spell rather than treated as employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Party membership and organisational office are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Member and party biographies corroborate ten years in local government; the secondary chronology supplies election and resignation dates. The final interval overlaps federal service because resignation from council followed the federal election.
career_spells.counting_note: Local elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary chronology supplies the first mayoral term dates; member-controlled biographies corroborate service as mayor. This office was nested within the councillor term.
career_spells.counting_note: Local elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the organisation, chair title and month boundaries. It does not state the legal form, remuneration, hours or whether the appointment was an incident of local elected office; governance is not assumed to be paid employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Intergovernmental/community governance is excluded from the narrow employment headline.

career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary chronology supplies the second mayoral term dates; member-controlled biographies describe five years as mayor in total. This office was nested within the councillor term.
career_spells.counting_note: Local elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Northern Sydney Regional Organisation of Councils
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the organisation, title and month boundaries. Remuneration, hours, legal form and whether the appointment was an incident of council office are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Regional council governance is excluded from the narrow employment headline.

career_spells.role: Non-Executive Director and Risk Committee Chair
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen extract supplies the non-executive directorship and month boundaries; the secondary biography adds Risk Committee chair. StateCover describes itself as a mutual owned by its member councils. Remuneration and meeting load are unresolved, and non-executive governance is not treated as substantive employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Board governance is displayed separately and excluded from the narrow public/private employment headline.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the organisation, office and month boundaries. The secondary biography describes the role as a directorship/treasurer office. Remuneration, hours and any separate employment relationship are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Employer-association governance is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the title and month boundaries. LGP describes itself as the procurement organisation for NSW councils and a prescribed entity under section 55 of the Local Government Act; LGNSW describes LGP as a proprietary company for which it recruits directors. Public evidence does not resolve payroll basis, hours, leave, substantive full-time status, or ultimate government control. The interval overlaps council, board and association offices and extends beyond the federal election month.
career_spells.counting_note: The role may be paid employment, but neither substantive full-time status nor a defensible public/private headline classification is established.

career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary biography reports advisory-board service but supplies no dates, remuneration, meeting load or employment relationship.
career_spells.counting_note: Advisory governance is excluded from the narrow employment headline.

career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary chronology records announcement as Labor candidate on 26 March 2022 and election on 21 May 2022. Remuneration, campaign hours and treatment of concurrent roles are unresolved; candidacy is not assumed to be employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Party and campaign activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Bennelong
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and current official profiles record House service from the 21 May 2022 election. Parliamentary and party-room responsibilities are nested within elected service.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.
